definitions.short: the butler or other officer in the Babylonian court
definitions.full: H4453. meltsar מֶלְצָר noun masculine a Babylonian title ; dubious; perhaps guardian ? (Schr COT Dan 1:11 Dl Baer Dn xi conjecture loan-word from Assyrian maƒ(ƒ)aru , keeper, guardian , compare Dl HWB 423 ; hardly connected with (modern) Persian mulsaru 'Kellermeister' (compare Meinh.), see against this Bev); — only with article ׳הַמּ 1:11 , 16 .
